_about: Which GitHub project each module is. scripts/upstream-meta.js reads the description, tagline, docs link and licence from here. null means the module keeps its own wording: bundles of several apps, closed-source apps, game servers (whose GitHub project is the Docker wrapper, not the game), projects not on GitHub, and Podhouse's own modules.

cloud.description: You can store your files, contacts, calendars, and more on a server of your choosing. You keep your files, contacts, calendars, and more synchronized amongst your devices.

dns.description: AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads and tracking. After you set it up, it'll cover ALL your home devices, and you don't need any client-side software for that.

files.description: FileBrowser Quantum provides an easy way to access and manage your files from the web. It has a modern responsive interface that has many advanced features to manage users, access, sharing, and file preview and editing.

pi-hole.description: The Pi-hole® is a DNS sinkhole that protects your devices from unwanted content without installing any client-side software.

stablediffusion.description: A web interface for Stable Diffusion, implemented using Gradio library.

stirling-pdf.description: Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services.
